pages.text:
Copper, wood and cobblestone are all you need to start.
Next steps shows what to do now. Each step you finish unlocks new recipes.
Click an icon for its recipe. Hover it for stats, hold Shift for more.
pages.title: Using the book

pages.text:
Each age starts with a new material.
0 Clockwork: copper, wood
1 Wired: iron, gold, redstone
2 Servo: diamond, obsidian
3 Deep: netherite, blaze rods
4 Antigrav: ender pearls, nether star
pages.title: Five ages

pages.text:
Every age has its own casing, circuit and motor, made from the parts of the age before.
A Metal Press gets twice the plates out of your ingots that the Tinker's Hammer does.
pages.title: The parts ladder

pages.text:
Start with the Winding Crank: wind a Mainspring by hand to run your first robots.
Once you have iron, build a Combustion Generator and feed it coal or logs.
In Age 1, add Solar Panels: no fuel to keep up.
After that come the RTG, the Tesla Spire and the Core Reactor.
pages.title: Making FE

pages.text:
Right-click a robot with a cell or Mainspring to swap it in.
A cell anywhere in your inventory recharges the FE tool in your hand and your Exo suit.
pages.title: Batteries

pages.text: Tesla Coils can link to other coils to reach further. Each hop loses 5%.
pages.title: Moving FE

pages.text: It makes circuits, motors and casings for about a quarter less than crafting them. Build one early in Age 2.
pages.title: Assembler

pages.text: Keep your spent pellets: they end up as Ring Collider fuel.
pages.title: Fuel

pages.text: Open a controller to see what is missing. Its spyglass button outlines the wrong block in the world.
pages.title: Multiblocks

pages.text: The Capacitor Bank and the Core Reactor are hollow boxes: casing on every edge, and casing, glass or ports in the walls. The controller goes in a side wall, facing out.
pages.title: Hollow boxes

pages.text:
Bank Ports: FE in or out, one direction each.
Capacitors: hold the FE.
Transfer Coils: how fast FE moves in and out, shared by all ports.
Mix Capacitors and Coils inside however you like.
pages.title: Capacitor Bank

pages.text: Glass goes in the walls, never on an edge.
pages.title: Smallest bank

pages.text:
A column under open sky: Spire Base, conductor blocks, Spire Crown on top.
Each metal sets power and how far fuel goes; mix them freely.
Build it high, and 64 blocks away from other spires.
Storms bring lightning: every strike fills the buffer with a burst.
The note block button in its screen mutes it.
pages.title: Tesla Spire

pages.text:
The middle block stays empty: the core floats there.
Amplifiers in the other 26 spots raise power but burn fuel and the core faster, for fewer FE per pellet. Stabilizers do the opposite.
A core in the core slot waits until the one inside burns out.
pages.title: Core Reactor

pages.text:
A flat loop of segments with the controller in it. Any shape works.
Charge it with FE (a Capacitor Bank helps), add fuel and press Running.
Do not let the fuel run out: the beam collapses and needs a new charge.
Bigger rings make Strange Matter faster.
pages.title: Ring Collider

pages.text:
Sprout also picks berries, melons, pumpkins, sugar cane, cactus, bamboo and kelp.
Sneak-right-click a robot to see its status and work area. A robot that smokes is stuck; its status says why.
pages.title: Stumpy and Sprout

pages.text:
Name or leash an animal to keep it from being culled.
Its lamp is green while working, amber with no feed and red when stuck.
pages.title: Rancher

pages.text:
Right-click a block to deploy it, sneak-right-click to pick it up. Give it a battery and torches.
Drone key (default H): dig where you look. With sneak: call it back.
pages.title: Mining Drone

pages.text: Repair it with iron.
pages.title: Sentry Drone

pages.text: A Courier Drone can run up to 4 routes.
pages.title: Courier and Hauler

pages.text:
Pair Speed cards with Efficiency cards: speed makes every action cost more FE.
Upgrading a placed machine to the next Mk keeps everything inside it.
pages.title: Upgrade cards

pages.text: It skips chests and other block entities in its way.
pages.title: Excavator

pages.text: A Magma Core in its core slot adds ancient debris and resonite.
pages.title: Survey Rig

pages.text:
FE gear can't be enchanted. Modules take the place of enchantments.
Higher module levels need a higher Age or Mk.
pages.title: Modules

pages.text:
Hold sneak to mine a single block.
Smithing a tool up keeps its energy, settings and modules.
pages.title: Drills

pages.text:
Overclock, Fortune and Silk Touch only work while the tool has FE.
Spark Lamps float and crackle. Sneak-right-click one with the Lamp Rod to remove it.
pages.title: Tool modules

pages.text: They replant from saplings in your inventory.
pages.title: Trees

pages.text: Chain Lightning fits the Arc Blade, Ricochet the Rivet Gun.
pages.title: Weapons

pages.text:
The chest in a Rusted Foundry holds a Signal Flare. Later you can craft flares and your own altar.
The altar has a 5 minute cooldown. The loot is locked to the killer for 2 minutes.
pages.title: Scrap Colossus

pages.text:
Arms up: it slams. Jump, or get 5 blocks away.
Arm back: it throws scrap. Keep moving.
Below half health it calls drones and overheats. When its furnace opens, hit it for double damage.
pages.title: Colossus fight

pages.text: The chest in a Cinder Forge holds an Ignition Charge.
pages.title: Forge Tyrant

pages.text:
Doors glow: flame breath. Step aside.
Crucible back: magma globs. Keep moving.
Hammer up: glowing rings on the ground. Get off them.
Doors open: it vents. Hit it for double damage.
pages.title: Tyrant fight

pages.text:
Out of FE it still works as armor, but its modules stop.
Smithing a piece up keeps its energy and modules. Mk4 pieces are fireproof.
pages.title: The suit

pages.text:
Needs a Mk2 chestplate and all four pieces at Mk2 or higher.
Servo: Haste and Speed on the Overclock key (default O).
Magma: fireproof, burning hits.
Antigrav: no fall damage, cheaper Flight.
pages.title: Core socket

pages.text:
It runs on a wound Mainspring from day one, or on any FE.
Plots next to each other join into one hall. Click a plot edge for a door, a seam for an inner wall. Shift-click forgets a plot.
pages.title: Architect Table

pages.text:
An Iron, Reinforced or Null Casing in the casing slot opens the next style.
The stonecutter turns style blocks into other shapes.
pages.title: Styles

pages.text:
Clearing voids junk and puts the rest in a chest touching the table.
Demolish gives back 75% of the matter for its own blocks.
pages.title: Clear and Demolish

pages.text:
Harvest mode gives loot and stores the mob's experience; Spawn mode makes the real mob.
Blazes, endermen and ghasts need a Magma Core in the controller, shulkers an Antigrav Core.
pages.title: Mob Replicator

pages.text: Any frame block can be glass, edges and corners too.
pages.title: Replicator layout

pages.text:
Taking damage cancels a remote teleport.
Portal Projectors work across dimensions.
pages.title: Warp

pages.text:
Search with @mod or #tag. The J button syncs the search with JEI.
Shulker boxes and bundles only go in empty.
pages.title: Storage Terminal

pages.text: Items go to the highest priority arm that has room. Round robin only spreads them between arms of the same priority.
pages.title: Item pipes

pages.text: Set each face in a machine's Sides tab. Auto-input pulls from Input faces, auto-eject pushes out of Output faces.
pages.title: Machine sides

## Generators

| Source | Age | FE/t |
|---|---|---|
| [[winding_crank]] | 0 | 100, by hand |
| [[combustion_generator]] | 1 | 80 |
| [[solar_panel_mk1]] to [[solar_panel_mk4]] | 1-4 | 20 to 320, by day |
| [[rtg]] | 2 | 150 |
| [Tesla Spire](#/guide/tesla-spire) | 2+ | about 500 to 27,000, plus lightning |
| [Core Reactor](#/guide/core-reactor) | 2-4 | 1,200 to 180,000 |
| [Ring Collider](#/guide/ring-collider) | 4 | 24,000 to 640,000 |

{{image shots/26_solar_panels.jpg|Solar Panels Mk1 to Mk4}}

## Storage

Cells ([[copper_cell]]) power robots and gear. For a base, use [[accumulator_1]] blocks, then a Capacitor Bank.

{{guide capacitor-bank}}

## Tesla Coils

Put a [[tesla_coil_1]] on a generator or battery and link it to machines with the [[tesla_linker]]: no cables needed. A coil anywhere else relays. Link machines straight to the source coil when you can: every relay hop loses some FE.

{{items tesla_coil_1 tesla_coil_2 tesla_coil_3 tesla_coil_4 tesla_coil_5 tesla_linker}}

{{image shots/11_tesla_network.jpg|A Tesla Coil network}}


## Charging your gear

A [[charger]] does one item at a time. The [[wireless_charger]] (Age 2) charges everything you and your team carry while you work nearby.

{{image shots/gui_wireless_charger.jpg|Wireless Charger menu}}

Setup steps are on the [[rancher]] page.

{{items rancher rancher_mk2}}

{{image shots/rancher_pen.jpg|Two Ranchers feeding and shearing in a fenced pen with a chest}}

- **Herd size** counts adults, split evenly over species with 2+ adults: 12 with cows, pigs and sheep keeps 4 of each.
- Below the share it breeds two adults with feed from the chest; above it, it culls one adult.
- Name or leash an animal to keep it from being culled.
- Drops, wool and milk go into the chest. Chest full: it stops culling, shearing and milking.
- **Shear** and **Milk** (on by default): sheep are sheared, cows and goats fill an empty bucket once a minute each. Turned off, those animals are bred and culled like the rest.

> Status in its menu and in Jade: Working, Idle, No energy, Storage full, No feed or No storage. The lamp on its chest shows it too: green working, dim green idle, amber no feed, blinking red for the rest.

guides.body:
## Parts

{{items spire_base spire_crown minecraft:copper_block minecraft:iron_block minecraft:diamond_block thorium_ingot thorium_fuel_pellet}}

## Build

1. Place the [[spire_base]] where nothing will ever sit above the column.
2. Stack 8 to 24 conductor blocks on it. Mix metals freely.
3. Put a [[spire_crown]] on top. It needs open sky.
4. Feed the base thorium ingots, thorium blocks or fuel pellets (hoppers work). FE leaves its sides and bottom.

{{multiblock tesla_spire}}

{{multiblock tesla_spire_mixed}}

## Conductors

Each block adds its power. The fuel efficiency of the column is the power-weighted average of its blocks: it sets how much FE one fuel item gives.

| Block | FE/t | Fuel efficiency |
|---|---|---|
| [[minecraft:copper_block]] (any oxidation) | 30 | 100% |
| [[minecraft:iron_block]] | 45 | 125% |
| [[minecraft:emerald_block]] | 60 | 175% |
| [[minecraft:gold_block]] | 90 | 75% |
| [[minecraft:diamond_block]] | 120 | 200% |
| [[pyrolite_block]] | 140 | 80% |
| [[resonite_block]] | 200 | 300% |
| [[minecraft:netherite_block]] | 500 | 300% |

Blocks of other mods' metals count too: tin, lead, nickel, aluminum, bronze, constantan, invar, steel, osmium, silver, electrum, signalum, lumium, enderium.

## Placement

- Output rises +0.25% per block the crown sits above Y 64, up to +50%.
- Rain gives x1.25, thunder x1.5.
- Every other spire within 64 blocks lowers it. Two spires side by side make as much as one.

## Lightning

A strike lands about every 6 minutes in clear weather, every 2 minutes in rain and every 30 s in a thunderstorm. It adds 30 s of full output to the buffer, fuel or not.

## Example outputs

| Column (crown at Y 72, clear sky) | Output |
|---|---|
| 16 copper | about 490 FE/t, a thorium pellet lasts about 7 minutes |
| 16 iron | about 730 FE/t |
| 16 diamond | about 1,950 FE/t |
| 24 netherite on a mountain, thunderstorm | about 27,000 FE/t |
guides.summary: The Age 2 lightning tower: a column of metal blocks that burns thorium and catches storms.

guides.body:
## Parts

{{items reactor_controller reactor_casing reactor_glass reactor_power_port reactor_access_port flux_amplifier graphite_damper servo_core}}

## Build

1. Build a 5x5x5 frame of [[reactor_casing]].
2. Fill the walls with casing, [[reactor_glass]], at least one [[reactor_power_port]] and any [[reactor_access_port]]s.
3. Put the [[reactor_controller]] in a side wall, screen facing out.
4. Leave the middle block empty: the core floats there. The other 26 inside blocks are air or modulators.
5. Add a core and fuel pellets. It works anywhere, underground included.

{{multiblock core_reactor}}

## Cores

| Core | Power |
|---|---|
| [[servo_core]] | x2 |
| [[magma_core]] | x6 |
| [[antigrav_core]] | x16 |

A core is used up like fuel: it loads from the core slot and lasts 168 hours of running at burn x1, shown by the core bar. Cores drop from bosses and can also be crafted. Keep the next one in the core slot.

## Modulators

| Block | Power | Burn |
|---|---|---|
| [[minecraft:redstone_block]] | +3% | +6% |
| [[flux_amplifier]] | +8% | +14% |
| [[pyro_amplifier]] | +15% | +25% |
| [[resonant_amplifier]] | +25% | +40% |
| [[minecraft:packed_ice]] | -2% | -2.5% |
| [[minecraft:blue_ice]] | -3% | -4% |
| [[graphite_damper]] | -4% | -5.5% |
| [[cryo_coolant]] | -6% | -9% |

Burn speeds up both the pellet and the core. Power and burn never drop below x0.25.

Amplifiers give fewer FE per pellet, stabilizers more. The most FE per pellet: 8 Cryo Coolant (power x0.52, burn x0.28, 1.86x FE per pellet).

## Example outputs

| Build | Output | Core lasts |
|---|---|---|
| Servo Core, thorium, empty | 1,200 FE/t | 168 h |
| Servo Core, thorium, 26 Flux Amplifiers | 3,700 FE/t | 36 h |
| Magma Core, enriched, empty | 9,000 FE/t | 168 h |
| Magma Core, enriched, 26 Pyro Amplifiers | 44,000 FE/t | 22 h |
| Antigrav Core, enriched, 26 Resonant Amplifiers | 180,000 FE/t | 15 h |

It pauses while its buffer is full, so a core never burns unused.
guides.summary: The fixed 5x5x5 reactor that burns fuel pellets and a boss core. Amplifiers trade run time for power.
guides.title: Build the Core Reactor

guides.body:
## Parts

{{items collider_controller accelerator_segment resonant_segment fusion_fuel_pellet strange_matter}}

## Build

1. Lay a flat closed loop of [[accelerator_segment]]s, 24 to 256 blocks long. Any shape works.
2. Put the [[collider_controller]] in the loop. Every loop block touches exactly two others.
3. Keep parallel stretches at least one block apart, or they join and branch.

{{multiblock ring_collider}}

{{multiblock ring_collider_resonant}}

## Running it

1. Charge it: 500,000 FE per loop block into the controller. A full Capacitor Bank does it in seconds.
2. Add [[fusion_fuel_pellet]]s and press Running. The charge is spent and the beam ramps up to full over 10 s.
3. Keep it fed. Out of fuel for 5 s, or switched off, the beam collapses and needs a new charge.

A pellet lasts 5 minutes in a 64 block ring; longer rings burn faster. Fuel needs [[radiant_isotope]] from centrifuged [[depleted_fuel_pellet]]s, so a Core Reactor or Tesla Spire feeds it.

## Output

The controller counts as one loop block.

| Ring | Output | One Strange Matter every |
|---|---|---|
| 24 blocks, Accelerator Segments | 23,000 FE/t | 28 minutes |
| 64 blocks, Accelerator Segments | 63,000 FE/t | 10 minutes |
| 128 blocks, Resonant Segments | 317,500 FE/t | 2.5 minutes |
| 256 blocks, Resonant Segments | 637,500 FE/t | 75 s |

While the buffer is full the beam pauses: no fuel burns and no Strange Matter forms.

[[strange_matter]] goes into [[null_circuit]]s without a nether star and into [[antigrav_core]]s in the Assembler.

{{guide capacitor-bank}}

1. Fill an [[essence_vial]] from the mob you want.
2. Build the 3x3x3: [[replicator_controller]] in the middle of one face, the rest of the shell [[replicator_frame]] and at least one [[replicator_glass]], the center air.
3. Put the full vial in the controller and power it.

{{items essence_vial replicator_controller replicator_frame replicator_glass}}

{{multiblock mob_replicator}}

## Modes

| Mode | What it does |
|---|---|
| Harvest (default) | Rolls the mob's loot into an 18-slot output. No entity spawns. The mob's XP is stored (up to 1,000,000 points). |
| Spawn | Spawns the real mob in front of the controller. Waits while 8 of that type (or 32 mobs) are within 8 blocks. |

{{image shots/gui_replicator_formed.jpg|Replicator Controller GUI, formed}}

- **To Lv** gives exactly enough XP to reach the target level (default 30).
- Breaking the controller drops the stored XP as orbs.
- A [[plasma_actuator]] in the boost slot doubles speed for extra FE.

## Tier gates

Catalyst slot (kept):

| Mobs | Needs |
|---|---|
| Blaze, enderman, guardian, ghast, wither skeleton, piglin brute | [[magma_core]] |
| Shulker | [[antigrav_core]] |

Boss drops, [[minecraft:nether_star]], [[minecraft:dragon_egg]] and the blacklist tags.

guides.body:
Each boss drops its age core every time and locks its loot to the killer for 2 minutes.

- A target they can't reach for 3 seconds gets hit from range, out to 40 blocks.
- With no player within 32 blocks for 30 seconds they heal.

## Scrap Colossus (Age 2)

{{items signal_flare colossus_altar servo_core}}

{{image shots/12_scrap_colossus.jpg|The Scrap Colossus on its altar}}

Find a Rusted Foundry (plains, deserts, badlands) or craft a [[colossus_altar]], then right-click it with a [[signal_flare]].

- Arms up: ground slam. Jump or back off. Arm back: thrown scrap.
- Below half health it calls Scrap Drones and overheats: hit the open furnace for double damage.

## Forge Tyrant (Age 3)

{{items ignition_charge forge_altar magma_core}}

{{image shots/27_forge_tyrant.jpg|The Forge Tyrant venting next to its Forge Altar}}

Find a Cinder Forge (blackstone ruins in Nether caves) or craft a [[forge_altar]], then right-click it with an [[ignition_charge]].

| Tell | Attack | Answer |
|---|---|---|
| Furnace doors glow | Flame breath, a 7 block cone | Step out of the cone |
| Crucible arm swings back | Magma globs | Keep moving |
| Hammer goes up | Glowing rings, then eruptions | Get off the rings |
| Doors swing open | Vent, after every 3 attacks | Hit it: double damage |

> Below half health it rings itself with eruptions and attacks faster. Fire Resistance helps.

guides.body:
{{items item_pipe item_pipe_mk2 item_pipe_mk3 item_pipe_mk4}}

{{image shots/17_item_pipes.jpg|Item Pipes from a chest through a Grinder and an Electric Furnace into a chest}}

Pipes of every tier connect; each Extract arm pulls at its own pipe's rate. Extract arms hand items to the Insert arms of the same line.

## Filters, order and priority

Right-click an arm to open its screen.

{{image shots/gui_item_pipe.jpg|The screen of a pipe arm: Extract, a whitelist of raw ores, Closest first}}

- Click a filter slot with an item to add it, or shift-click the item in your inventory. Click the slot again to clear it.
- **Blacklist** (default): listed items do not pass. **Whitelist**: only listed items pass. An empty filter lets everything through.
- On an Extract arm the filter picks what gets pulled; on an Insert arm it picks what goes in.
- Extract arms have an order: **Round robin** spreads items over every Insert arm in turn, **Closest first** fills the nearest Insert arm (fewest pipes away) and only sends the rest on.
- Insert arms have a priority: **Highest**, **High** (default), **Normal**, **Low** or **Lowest**. Click to lower it, shift-click to raise it. Items go to the highest priority that takes them; lower ones get the rest. Round robin spreads within one priority.
- Filters match the item, not its damage or enchantments.

Example: one chest feeds a Grinder and a Furnace. Whitelist ores on the Grinder arm, raw food on the Furnace arm.

## Machine sides

Grinder, Electric Furnace, Alloy Smelter, Centrifuge, Assembler, RTG and Metal Press have a **Sides** tab right of their screen.

- Click a face: Input, Output, Input + Output or None. Right-click goes back.
- **Auto-input** pulls from chests on Input faces, **auto-eject** pushes results into chests on Output faces: up to 16 items every 10 ticks. Both start off.
- Pipes and hoppers follow the same rules. None means pipes do not connect.
- Default: every face both ways; Grinder and Electric Furnace bottom Output only.
guides.summary: Filters, order and priority on pipe arms, and which machine face takes items in or gives them out.

guides.body:
Right-click a machine with a card, or put it in an upgrade slot. One kind per slot; stackable kinds stack in that slot, every card one step.

{{items upgrade_speed upgrade_efficiency upgrade_range upgrade_fortune upgrade_silk upgrade_growth upgrade_void upgrade_height upgrade_carry}}

## The Mk rule

Every machine with a Mk (Alloy Smelter, Centrifuge, Assembler, Grinder, Electric Furnace, Excavator, Survey Rig, Stumpy and Sprout with Farm Kits):

{{mkrule}}

Right-click a placed machine with the next Mk: it swaps in place and keeps its contents, cards and energy.

Machines without a Mk (Metal Press, Combustion Generator, Wireless Charger, Replicator, Architect Table, drones) have fixed slots: see their pages.

> Every speed card costs more FE per action than the one before: 1 card +30%, 8 cards x6.2. The quarries pay a steeper price: 8 cards cost 21x the FE per block in the [[excavator_mk4]].

[Which machine takes which card](#/upgrades)

steps.text: Smith a Null Drill and dig a 12x12x12 cube in one swing.
steps.title: Big Holes

steps.text: Light the beam of a Ring Collider.
steps.title: Smash Hit

steps.text: Put a Flight Module in an Exo chestplate and press the Flight key (default K) to fly.
steps.title: Lift Off

steps.text: Smith an Exo piece to Mk4.
steps.title: Null Frame

steps.text: Link two Portal Projectors with a Linking Card and step through the portal.
steps.title: Through the Lens

carry.name: Carry Upgrade
carry.rules: Right-click the terminal with it. It stays in for good.
carry.summary: Storage Terminal keeps its items when picked up.

efficiency.name: Efficiency Upgrade
efficiency.rules: Never below 40% of the base cost.
efficiency.summary: Machines use 15% less FE per action per card. Combustion Generator: 10% less fuel per card.

fortune.name: Fortune Upgrade
fortune.rules: Not together with a Silk Touch card.
fortune.summary: Fortune I-III on mined blocks, more Grinder and Alloy Smelter output, Looting in the Replicator.

growth.name: Growth Upgrade
growth.summary: Farm bots: +50% crop and sapling growth per card.

height.name: Height Upgrade
height.summary: Architect Table: buildings one block taller per card.

range.name: Range Upgrade
range.rules: What a step means depends on the machine.
range.summary: Bigger work area or range, more items per Electric Furnace lane.

silk.name: Silk Touch Upgrade
silk.rules: Single card. Not together with Fortune.

speed.name: Speed Upgrade
speed.rules: Each card is one step: x2, x3, x4, x6, x8, x11, x15, x20.
speed.summary: Machines work faster and use more FE per action.

void.name: Void Upgrade
void.summary: Deletes junk or outputs that don't fit.

effects.fortune: +10% main output per card on ores and raw ores, not gem ores.
effects.speed: Grinds faster (x2, x3, x4, x6, x8, x11, x15, x20); FE/t rises with it.
effects.void: Extra outputs that don't fit are deleted instead of stalling.

effects.range: +1 item per lane and cycle per card.
effects.speed: Smelts faster (x2, x3, x4, x6, x8, x11, x15, x20).

effects.fortune: 10% chance per card of one more alloy; +25% FE/t each.
effects.speed: Faster crafts (x2, x3, x4, x6, x8, x11, x15, x20); FE/t rises.

effects.fortune: Only on recipes that allow it (none by default).
effects.speed: Faster crafts (x2, x3, x4, x6, x8, x11, x15, x20); FE/t rises.
effects.void: Chance results that don't fit vanish instead of stalling.

effects.fortune: Only on recipes that allow it (none by default).
effects.speed: Faster crafts (x2, x3, x4, x6, x8, x11, x15, x20); FE/t rises.

effects.efficiency: -10% fuel per FE per card (4 cards: 1.67x FE per fuel item).
effects.speed: FE/t x2, x3, x4; fuel burns faster still (more fuel per FE).

effects.growth: +50% sapling growth in the area per card.
+50% crop growth in the area per card.

effects.range: +4 blocks of range per card (8 without, 24 with 4).
effects.speed: Charges faster: x2, x3, x4, x6 FE/t per player.

effects.range: Hole +10 blocks wide per card (Mk1 8 -> 18, Mk4 24 -> 64).
effects.speed: Digs faster (x2, x3, x4, x6, x8, x11, x15, x20); FE per block x1.75 / x3 / x7 / x21 at 1 / 2 / 4 / 8 cards.
effects.void: Deletes cobblestone, dirt, gravel and other junk.

effects.efficiency: Takes 15% per card off the steep speed factor.
effects.fortune: Fortune I-III on every ore roll.
effects.silk: Ores come out as ore blocks.
effects.speed: More ores (x2 ... x20); FE/t climbs much faster: x3.5 / x9 / x42 / x420 at 1 / 2 / 4 / 8 cards.

effects.fortune: Looting I-III on the mob's loot.

effects.height: Buildings one block taller per card (up to 12).

effects.range: +4 blocks guard and attack range per card.

effects.speed: Flies faster: x2, x3 (max 3 blocks per tick).

effects.carry: Keeps every item inside when picked up.

upgrades.rule: Machines with a Mk: Mk + 1 card slots; speed 2 per Mk, efficiency 1, range 1 and growth 1 per Mk, fortune up to 3, silk and void 1. Machines without a Mk have fixed slots.
